Name: Raphael Seasonal Portraits by Chogo
Author: deleted96844928
Description:
Check out my version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7123/]Lunna[/url]!

I changed Raphael's portraits because he's probably my favorite character from the mod! 
It's seasonal and also has different portraits in each festival!
I really really have to thank the creator of the mod, Rafseazz. Not only did they make an amazing mod, but they actually helped me create this one aswell.

Just download the file and put it in your Mods folder, it won't overwrite anything.
It requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna - Astray in Stardew Valley [/url]﻿by Rafseazz.

Downloads.Description: Drop it into your Mods files.
